name: Superscription Inscription
overview: The superscription inscription placed above Jesus on the cross boldly declared Him as "The King of the Jews," as recorded in Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. This title, written in multiple languages according to Luke, was a public and official proclamation of Jesus’ identity and the charge against Him. Far from a mere label, this inscription reveals the truth of Christ's kingship, affirming His messianic role even in the moment of crucifixion.
